title: Scala Data Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines that enable high‑quality analytics and data consumption across the organisation. This role focuses on developing efficient ETL/ELT solutions using Scala, SQL, and Apache Spark, working with cloud data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and supporting workloads on OCI. The individual will collaborate closely with analytics, data science, and product teams to ensure data reliability, performance, and availability at scale.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build, maintain, and optimise scalable and reliable data pipelines for analytics and downstream data consumption
* Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using Scala, SQL, and Apache Spark for large‑scale data processing
* Work with distributed systems and big data technologies to process high‑volume datasets efficiently
* Leverage cloud‑native data services on GCP and support workloads on OCI where required
* Ensure data quality, performance, availability, and reliability across all data pipelines
* Collaborate with analytics, data science, and product teams to deliver clean, well‑structured, and consumable datasets

**Who You Are**

* 4 to 6yrs experienced data engineering professional with strong hands‑on exposure to big data processing
* Skilled in distributed data processing frameworks with a solid understanding of performance optimisation
* Experienced in designing robust, scalable, and maintainable data architectures
* Proficient in Scala programming and advanced SQL for complex data transformations and analytical queries
* Hands‑on with Apache Spark and big data ecosystems, including Cassandra and Redis
* Experienced with GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Storage
* Comfortable working in multi‑cloud environments, with exposure to OCI considered an advantage
* A collaborative communicator with strong problem‑solving skills and a focus on data quality and reliability
* German language proficiency is desirable

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* Opportunities to work on large‑scale, cloud‑based data platforms with global impact
* Exposure to complex data engineering challenges across multi‑cloud environments
* Collaboration with diverse, cross‑functional teams across analytics, data science, and product domains
* A supportive environment that values learning, inclusion, and continuous improvement

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced optimisation techniques for distributed data processing at scale
* Deeper expertise in GCP data services and exposure to OCI cloud capabilities
* Best practices for building reliable, high‑quality data pipelines in enterprise environments
* Enhanced collaboration skills through close work with analytics and product stakeholders

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio‑economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
  
  
**Alert**
Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  
  
#JDEnhancedByTARA
  
  
**Follow us on social media and #StayConnected**

title: Data Engineer 1
description:
**Job Summary**
Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
  
  
**Competencies**
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
  
  
Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.
  
  
Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:
  
  

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
* Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
* Exposure to Agile software development
* Exposure to building analytical solutions
* Exposure to IoT technology

**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**

* Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers. 3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.
  
  
**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies. 2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products. 3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability. 4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders. 5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products. 2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Brief Description**
Job summary: We are a leading Software as a Service (SaaS) company that specializes in the transformation of data in the US healthcare industry through cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions. We are looking for Software Developers, who should continually strive to advance engineering excellence and technology innovation. The mission is to power the next generation of digital products and services through innovation, collaboration, and transparency. You will be a technology leader and doer who enjoys working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

* Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest and transform large datasets from various sources.
* Optimize and manage databases (SQL/NoSQL) to ensure efficient data storage, retrieval, and manipulation for both structured and unstructured data.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers to integrate data from disparate sources and ensure smooth data flow between systems.

* Expertise in SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra).
* Strong proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java for data manipulation and pipeline development.
* Experience with cloud-based platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) and their data services (e.g., S3, Redshift, BigQuery).

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
**Senior Data Engineer – Healthcare Data (Veradigm)**
**Overview**
Veradigm is seeking a
**Senior Data Engineer**
to support the design, development, and optimization of healthcare data solutions that power analytics, reporting, and client deliverables. This role is critical in enabling scalable, compliant, and high-quality data pipelines across clinical, claims, and operational datasets.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep experience in
**healthcare data ecosystems**
, strong technical expertise in
**Azure-based data platforms**
, and a proven ability to partner with cross-functional teams to deliver client-focused solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines supporting healthcare data ingestion, transformation, and delivery

+ Sources may include claims, EHR/EMR, eligibility, pharmacy, and third-party datasets

* Develop and maintain SQL Server stored procedures that drive core data transformation logic across client-specific and standardized pipelines
* Implement complex transformation logic using T-SQL, including mapping, validation, aggregation, and data standardization
* Optimize performance of SQL queries, stored procedures, and ETL processes to ensure efficient large-scale data processing
* Develop and optimize data solutions within Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake, SQL, Databricks)
* Lead efforts in data onboarding and implementation, ensuring timely and accurate client data integration
* Partner closely with Professional Services, Product, DevOps, and Analytics teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and validation, including reconciliation and audit processes for healthcare datasets
* Implement and maintain data governance and compliance standards, including HIPAA and PHI handling requirements
* Design and document data models, mappings, and transformation logic for standardized and reusable data assets
* Support troubleshooting and resolution of data pipeline failures, performance issues, and client-impacting defects
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives to streamline onboarding, reduce implementation timelines, and enhance data reliability
* Mentor junior team members and promote best practices in data engineering and documentation

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, preferably within healthcare or regulated data environments
* Strong proficiency in SQL and T-SQL, with hands-on experience building complex stored procedures and data transformations
* Experience with SQL Server performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies
* Strong Python (or similar programming language) skills
* Hands-on experience with Azure data services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Azure SQL, Blob Storage/Data Lake)
* Experience designing and managing ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines
* Solid understanding of healthcare data structures (claims, encounters, provider, member, etc.)
* Experience with data warehousing and modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with healthcare analytics domains such as Risk Adjustment, Quality Measures, or Value-Based Care
* Knowledge of FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare interoperability standards
* Experience with big data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Databricks)
* Exposure to Power BI or other BI/visualization tools
* Experience supporting client-facing implementations or onboarding projects

**Key Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data accuracy
* Ability to translate complex healthcare data requirements into scalable solutions
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

**What Success Looks Like**

* Successful, on-time delivery of client data onboarding and implementations
* High-performing, reliable data pipelines with strong data quality controls
* Efficient, well-optimized SQL processes supporting large-scale healthcare datasets
* Scalable, reusable data solutions supporting multiple healthcare clients
* Improved time-to-value for clients through streamlined processes and automation

Strong collaboration across teams, with clear ownership and accountability

description:

Dataction has built a reputation for providing differentiated and reliable services to a wide range of customers across multiple sectors.

Our lean, agile, and analytical approach towards problem solving and execution, helps our client achieve sustainable growth and secure a profitable business, while safeguarding a viable future. Our people are committed, courageous, and unafraid of pushing boundaries. They help our clients make decisions that deliver immediate and measurable benefits, justifying investments. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for the maintenance and enhancements of the data estate across the business, whilst supporting the day to day activities of the wider data team.
  
  
Reporting to the UK based Group Data Controller and working alongside the Technology teams with maintaining & enhancing current data systems in the chosen tech stack of the business, this includes data request, producing automated datasets, developing and maintaining new and existing data movement processes including ETLs and real time event data processing.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Database Management & Enhancement:**

* Maintain & enhance existing transactional databases to ensure high data quality and performance.
* Data Warehouse Management ensuring the data warehouse contains all relevant sources of data from across the business, adding additional data sources where gaps are identified.
* Refine and review the current database structures implementing efficiency improvements to manual processes.
* Ensure best practices are used for database performance & data validation techniques.
* Ensure all code changes are stored in the source control system, reviewing code and suggesting code improvements where applicable.

* Ensuring all data processes and data stores have fully up-to-date documentation to capture the types of data stored.
* Support the data protection team with requests and process amendments.
* Processes confidential data and personal data according to legislations of each country UP Fitness operates in.
* Compile and update documentation around the data estate for non-technical stakeholders to consume and understand the different data sources.

* Assist the Group Data Controller with the rollout of Data Science & Machine Learning into the business.

* Involvement in key decisions around dataset usage across the data estate including reporting and analytical datasets.
* Increase the quality of the data available to other teams within the business for further analytical processes to be carried out.

**Qualifications, Skills And Experience**

* 7+ years of Data engineering experience
* A bachelor's degree in data management, data engineering, data science, or a related field.
* Certified in AWS or any other Data related technologies.
* Previous experience in Data Engineering Role.
* Experience with AWS & SQL server data tools.
* Experience in developing scalable and efficient ETL processes to move data around the estate.
* Mentoring Experience of Data Team members.
* Experience in Lambdas, Event Bus, Python
* Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong verbal and numerical skills
* Integrity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct in handling sensitive information and adhering to professional standards and regulations.
* Evidence of complex data problem solving skills
* Experience interacting with employees, managers, and documenting policies and procedures.
* Strong knowledge of database design & performance tuning techniques
* Solid understanding of data movement, data security & meta data.
* Power Platform knowledge in a production environment
* Data Science & Machine Learning Methods

**Softskills**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor and coach teams, driving adoption of best practices.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on scalable solutions.
* Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable in fast-paced agile environments.

**Why should you join Dataction?**
Fairness, Meritocracy, Empowerment, And Opportunity Are Pillars Of Our Work Culture. In Addition To a Competitive Salary, You Can Look Forward To
  
  

* Great work-life balance through hybrid work arrangement.
* Company funded skill enhancement and training.
* Exciting reward and recognition program.
* Opportunity to bond with colleagues through exciting employee engagement initiatives.

title: Data Engineer

You will collaborate with customer technical teams, solution architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems for generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; support platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply Oracle product capabilities in customer deployments. 5–8 years of experience designing, building, and delivering scalable data platforms. Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Software Engineer, AI Engineer, Consulting Engineer, or similar technical role. Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms like Databricks. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, and modern data ecosystems; experience with Scala, Java, or Kafka is a plus. Exposure to building AI agents and orchestration pipelines. Strong understanding of Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance optimization, and tuning. Experience modernizing analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads. Working understanding of networking concepts to support data connectivity, configuration, and troubleshooting. Working knowledge of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability. Strong communication, customer collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. ResponsibilitiesDesign and deliver Oracle AI Data Platform solutions, including platform implementations and migrations. Build scalable, governed, AI-ready data pipelines, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products. Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns. Works with key business stakeholders, IT experts and subject-matter experts to plan, design and deliver optimal analytics and data science solutions. Works on one or many product teams at a time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Designs and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Designs and implements framework to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. title: Lead Data Engineer - Data Modeler
description:
Our mission at LendingClub is to empower those who strive to achieve better
  
  
financial health. Data intelligence team plays a crucial role in achieving our
  
  
mission.
  
  
We are seeking a Lear Data Modeling Engineer for our Data team to provide data
  
  
modeling, data processing, and pipeline orchestration capabilities. You’ll be part of
  
  
the Data Intelligence organization that helps drive business decisions using data.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to use your expertise in data modeling, software
  
  
development, design thinking, and analytical skills to build scalable data pipelines,
  
  
robust data models, and high-quality data products leveraging our PB-scale data.
  
  
This role is primarily focused on data modeling, with strong ownership of building
  
  
and supporting the data pipelines and systems that operationalize those models.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and evolving data models in a centralized
  
  
data warehouse, ensuring they are scalable, performant, and aligned with business
  
  
needs. In parallel, you will contribute to engineering development to ensure
  
  
reliable data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
  
  
You will also play a key role in driving data standardization efforts, establishing
  
  
consistent definitions, modeling patterns, and data quality practices across the
  
  
organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-quality data models in a

centralized data warehouse (primary focus)
  
  

* Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models

that support analytics and downstream applications
  
  

* Define and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and best

practices across domains
  
  

* Lead and contribute to data standardization initiatives to ensure

consistency and interoperability of data assets
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines that support and operationalize data

models (ingestion, transformation, and delivery)
  
  

* Develop pipelines that transform raw data into clean, well-modeled,

analytics-ready datasets
  
  

* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Program teams to deliver endto-end data solutions (models + pipelines)
* Optimize data models and pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost

efficiency
  
  

* Implement processes for data validation, quality monitoring, and reliability
* Write high-quality, testable code; adopt TDD and contribute to engineering

documentation and best practices
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis on data and pipeline issues to improve system

robustness
  
  
**About You**

* 10+ years of experience and a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,

Information Systems, or related field; or equivalent experience
  
  

* Strong expertise in data modeling (dimensional modeling, warehouse

design, normalization techniques)
  
  

* Proven experience designing and implementing data models in

centralized/cloud data warehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
  
  

* Solid experience in data engineering and pipeline development to support

modeled data layers
  
  

* 5+ years of experience with Databricks and DBT
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster
* In-depth experience with distributed systems such as Spark
* Strong programming skills (Java, Scala, Python) with experience building

production-grade data pipelines
  
  

* Experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, EMR, RDS)
* Strong understanding of data standardization, data governance, and data

quality best practices
  
  

* Experience with Git, JIRA, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment
* You are passionate about data modeling and designing scalable, wellstructured datasets
* You are equally comfortable implementing pipelines that bring those

models to life
  
  

* You think in terms of data consistency, reusability, and long-term

maintainability
  
  

* You value clean design, simplicity, and high-quality engineering practices
* You have a track record of delivering reliable, well-modeled, production - ready data solutions

title: Data Engineer + Instructor
description:
**About Newton School of Technology:**
NST is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a four-year B.Tech programme in Computer Science and AI, emphasising hands-on learning, industry integration, and real-world problem-solving.

With industry-focused projects, practical learning opportunities, and exposure to emerging technologies, NST aims to prepare students for advanced technology careers. Its faculty brings together academic expertise and industry experience to create an engaging, outcome-driven learning environment.

**About the Role:**
We are looking for an experienced
**Data Engineer & Data Visualisation Instructor**
to join our academic team in Pune.

This role combines technical expertise with teaching, mentoring, and curriculum development. The ideal candidate will have strong practical knowledge of databases, SQL, data engineering, and data visualisation, along with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into engaging, hands-on learning experiences.

You will design and deliver industry-relevant courses, mentor students through practical assignments and capstone projects, and help develop the next generation of data professionals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Curriculum Development**

* Design and develop course content, lesson plans, lab exercises, and assessments covering DBMS, data engineering, and data visualisation.
* Develop practical assignments and projects aligned with industry practices and current technologies.
* Continuously update curriculum content to reflect emerging trends in databases, business intelligence, analytics, and cloud technologies.

**2. Teaching and Training**

* Deliver lectures, workshops, and hands-on sessions on database management systems, SQL, data modelling, and database design.
* Teach relational database concepts, normalisation, indexing, query optimisation, transactions, and database security.
* Train students in Python, data processing, ETL/ELT concepts, and introductory data pipeline development.
* Teach data visualisation and reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or equivalent tools.
* Introduce students to data warehousing, cloud databases, and relevant industry use cases.

**3. Practical Projects and Industry Application**

* Design real-world projects involving data collection, transformation, analysis, and visualisation.
* Develop capstone projects that integrate data engineering, business intelligence, and, where relevant, AI/ML applications.
* Incorporate industry scenarios and datasets to help students develop practical problem-solving skills.
* Guide students in building portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their technical capabilities.

**4. Student Assessment and Mentorship**

* Develop quizzes, assignments, coding exercises, and project-based assessments.
* Evaluate student performance and provide actionable feedback.
* Mentor students in debugging, troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and technical problem-solving.
* Support students in building career-ready skills and preparing for data engineering, database, and analytics roles.

**5. Industry Collaboration**

* Stay updated on industry tools, technologies, and best practices.
* Conduct technical workshops, guest sessions, hackathons, and project demonstrations.
* Collaborate with other faculty members to integrate data concepts into multidisciplinary projects.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of teaching methodologies and learning outcomes.

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field or Phd in computer science
* **Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience**
  in data engineering, database development, BI/data analytics, or related technical roles.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly and mentor others.
* Prior teaching, training, mentoring, or technical enablement experience is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one major relational database, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Good understanding of database design, data modelling, normalisation, indexing, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
* Working knowledge of Python for data processing and automation.
* Practical experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT workflows, data pipelines, and data warehousing concepts.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB is an advantage.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms and services, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A hands-on technology professional who enjoys teaching and mentoring.
* Someone who can bridge the gap between theoretical concepts and real-world industry applications.
* A candidate who can build engaging learning experiences and guide students through practical projects.
* A collaborative individual who is passionate about developing future-ready technology talent.

* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.

* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
* Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).

* Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.
* Experience using Oracle SQL Developer Migration Workbench or equivalent schema conversion tools.

* Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and migration automation.
* Ability to optimize SQL queries and improve migration performance for high-volume datasets.
* Perform end-to-end data assessment, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents and migration specifications.
* Execute complex SQL-based reconciliation and data validation activities.
* Identify and resolve migration defects, mapping inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Conduct pre-migration, mock migration, production migration, and post-migration verification.
* Support migration testing including SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation. Page 4 of 4 CONFIDENTIAL ERD-3-01b, Job Description Template, Rev. 13.0, Eff. 02/22/2023
* Perform record-level reconciliation to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy of migrated pharmacovigilance data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
* 7+ years of relevant experience in safety IT Systems

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Data Platform Engineer**
At Johnson Controls, you will help build and operate the data platform behind OpenBlue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the streaming and lakehouse pipelines that deliver trusted building and energy data to the applications our customers rely on.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and maintain pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and help run them on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from code to production, and take on more design ownership over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Kafka and Flink streaming jobs for ingestion and transformation.
* Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
* Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Support routine database and lakehouse operations, including Iceberg table maintenance and PostgreSQL backups and tuning.

**How You Will Do It**

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
* Stay close to work by understanding how the data you build is used downstream.
* Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
* Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in software or data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, with working knowledge of or eagerness to learn the rest.
* Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, and solid SQL skills.
* Understanding of distributed systems basics such as partitioning, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
* Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
* Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in a cloud environment.
* Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, or TimescaleDB.
* Experience with React and TypeScript.
* Azure experience.
* Production experience with AKS, Helm, or Kubernetes operators for Flink, Spark, or Kafka.
* Experience with time-series or IoT data.
* Experience with Terraform or Bicep and GitOps tools (Flux or Argo CD).
* Azure networking and security basics, including VNets, private endpoints, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

title: Principal Data Platform Architect
description:

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Principal Data Platform Architect
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is seeking a highly influential Principal Data Platform Architect to help define and deliver the next generation of enterprise data capabilities.
  
  
This role will lead the design and evolution of strategic platforms that simplify how external data is securely exchanged with Mastercard and enable product teams, consultants, and analysts to more easily discover, access, and leverage enterprise data. The successful candidate will help transform complex, fragmented data processes into scalable, self-service experiences that accelerate innovation and unlock greater value from Mastercard's data assets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define Enterprise Data Platform Strategy
  
  
Drive the technical vision and architecture for enterprise data onboarding, exchange, discovery, and consumption capabilities.
  
  
Develop roadmaps that balance immediate business needs with long-term platform scalability and reuse.
  
  
Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring data workflows across Mastercard.
  
  
Enable Frictionless Data Exchange
  
  
Design capabilities that streamline the secure onboarding, sharing, and management of external data.
  
  
Establish reusable patterns for data integration, governance, observability, lineage, and compliance.
  
  
Reduce reliance on bespoke solutions through automation and self-service capabilities.
  
  
Democratize Access to Data
  
  
Create intuitive ways for product teams, consultants, analysts, and AI-powered solutions to discover and utilize trusted enterprise data.
  
  
Enable self-service analytics and rapid solution development without requiring deep technical expertise.
  
  
Partner with governance and security teams to balance accessibility with appropriate controls.
  
  
Provide Technical Leadership
  
  
Serve as a technical authority across multiple engineering organizations.
  
  
Influence architecture and technology decisions without direct authority.
  
  
Establish engineering standards, best practices, and reference architectures.
  
  
Mentor engineers and architects across the organization.
  
  
Partner Across the Business
  
  
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Security, and business stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.
  
  
Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
Build alignment around platform investments and strategic priorities.
  
  
**All About You**
Extensive experience architecting and building large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise integration solutions across both on-premises and cloud environments, leveraging technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, NiFi, Hadoop/Cloudera, Databricks, and modern cloud-native data services.
  
  
Deep expertise in data engineering, data architecture, data integration, and cloud-native platforms.
  
  
Experience building reusable platforms that serve multiple products, teams, or business domains.
  
  
Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, security, metadata, and data quality practices.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across organizations.
  
  
Exceptional communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Proven track record of translating ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data ecosystems (Oracle, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.).
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:

* Document system architectures integration patterns and configuration standards for execution platforms so that support teams and stakeholders can clearly understand dependencies and maintenance procedures
* Coordinate and perform system upgrades patches and configuration changes during day shifts in a controlled manner to minimize disruption while keeping execution environments secure and current
* Support validation and testing activities by preparing test data executing test cases and confirming that execution systems meet functional performance and compliance expectations before release to production
* Provide guidance and mentoring to peers on best practices in Azure DevOps GITHUB RDBMS and AVEVA PI Historian so that the broader team can consistently deliver high quality execution solutions

**Qualifications**

* Apply advanced knowledge of Azure DevOps to define pipeline stages artifact management and environment strategies that align with execution system lifecycle needs and organizational governance
* Use deep experience in GITHUB and related workflows to maintain clean repositories code reviews and collaboration models that support stable development of execution system applications and services
* Leverage strong RDBMS expertise including schema design indexing and query tuning to ensure that execution data structures support reporting integration and long term maintainability
* Utilize extensive hands on proficiency with AVEVA PI Historian including tag configuration interface management and data compression settings to deliver reliable industrial data infrastructure
* Draw on practical exposure to manufacturing processes to design execution solutions that respect shop floor constraints production sequencing and quality considerations for real world plants
* Apply understanding of supply chain concepts such as demand planning inventory flows and logistics to shape execution data models and integrations that provide end to end visibility
* Operate effectively within a hybrid work model by using collaboration tools structured communication and disciplined documentation practices to maintain continuity between remote and onsite activities

title: dbt Cloud Data Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management software.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
You will develop, operate, and continuously improve production transformations in dbt Cloud and Snowflake for Global Customer Success. Advanced, hands-on dbt capability is a must. This role is responsible for the daily operation of dbt jobs: building models, processing complex and high-volume datasets efficiently, monitoring execution, resolving failures, and ensuring reliable outputs for data products, analytics, and AI use cases.
  
  
Working closely with the dbt Cloud Solution Architect, Data Engineer, and Data Scientists on our team, you will design and refine SQL models to deliver on business requirements. You will fine-tune the strategies for incremental processing and materialization, move changes through bronze/silver/gold layers into downstream data products, and enhance the data CI/CD processes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, test, document, deploy, and operate dbt models and jobs each day in dbt Cloud and Snowflake, transforming Global Customer Success source data into reliable, reusable data products.
* Process complex, high-volume datasets efficiently by applying appropriate model boundaries, incremental logic, materializations, scheduling, warehouse use, and reuse of transformed data.
* Monitor dbt job execution, runtime, failures, regressions, and Snowflake compute consumption; investigate issues and implement optimizations that reduce processing workload and cost.
* Work with and help develop the CI/CD, code-review, testing, release, and documentation standards for our growing data team.
* Work with data scientists, dashboard developers, and AI application owners to verify that production outputs meet downstream requirements, while maintaining models, tests, lineage, runbooks, and technical documentation that build long-term internal capacity.
* Define use of cutting-edge dbt features such as semantic view deployment, dbt Fusion, and dbt Wizard.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced, hands-on expertise with dbt Cloud, including daily development and operation of production transformations—this is a non-negotiable requirement for the role.
* Advanced SQL skills and experience using Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform to transform complex, high-volume datasets efficiently.
* Strong working knowledge of dbt models, sources, tests, macros, packages, documentation, lineage, incremental processing, snapshots, materializations, and job orchestration.
* Experience monitoring job execution and diagnosing failures, regressions, runtime, warehouse behavior, and compute consumption, with evidence of implementing workload and cost optimizations.
* Experience working across separated development, quality, and production environments with Git-based CI/CD practices, including branching, pull requests, automated testing, controlled promotion, release validation, and rollback support.
* Ability to operate and support production dbt workloads, document resolutions and operating procedures, and communicate risks, tradeoffs, and downstream impacts to technical and business partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Python or another scripting language for data validation, automation, or pipeline support.
* dbt certification or a portfolio demonstrating substantial dbt delivery experience.
* Experience with Snowflake performance, workload monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Experience building data products for telemetry, customer health, SaaS, sales, services, or Customer Success use cases.
* Familiarity with APIs, file-based ingestion, orchestration tools, data quality frameworks, and metadata/catalog platforms.
* Experience working in a globally distributed Agile or product-oriented data team.

Why Us
  
  
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
#SaaS
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

description:
**About Calfus**

At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era. Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. Our ERP solution teams have successfully implemented cloud solutions and developed tools that seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, reducing manual work so teams can focus on high-impact tasks.

None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we’re actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications.

As one of the fastest-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed—without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high-energy, driven individuals.

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!

**About the role:**

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer who's done more than execute pipelines inside someone else's design. If you've independently architected a data model — Star Schema, Data Vault, or a Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) Lakehouse — and can walk through the trade-offs you made, not just the tools you used, keep reading.

**What you'll actually own:**

* Design and own dimensional and Lakehouse data models from scratch — Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Data Vault, or Medallion architecture, chosen for the problem, not defaulted to
* Build ETL/ELT pipelines you'd trust without watching them — CDC, incremental loads, watermarking, real error handling, the stuff that doesn't page you at 2am
* Go deep on Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, cluster tuning, Z-Order) or Snowflake (multi-cluster warehouses, clustering keys, performance tuning) — architecture and platform ownership, not notebook execution
* Use PySpark and Spark SQL for real distributed processing at scale
* Write SQL that holds up under production load, not just queries that return the right answer once

**What we need to see, not just hear about:**

* 4–8 years of hands-on data engineering, with modeling you designed independently — able to explain
  *why*
  you chose the schema you chose
* Real ownership of Databricks or Snowflake at the architecture level, not just usage
* Strong Python and PySpark
* Azure (ADF, ADLS, Synapse) and/or AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift) — production experience, not a course completion
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field

**Nice to have, not a gate:**

* Power BI or Tableau — genuinely valued, but we won't screen out a strong architecture-first engineer who partners with BI rather than builds dashboards themselves
* Kafka or Kinesis, dbt, Microsoft Fabric
* DP-203, Databricks Data Engineer Associate, SnowPro Core, or PL-300

We work with enterprise clients where the data problems are genuinely hard and the ownership is real. If that's the kind of work you're looking for, we should talk.

**Benefits:**

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit.

**Calfus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

We believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone—regardless of background, identity, or experience—has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
IT&S Group
  
  
**Job Description**
Staff Data Engineer
  
  
Individual Contributor, Grade G
  
  
**About The Role**
The Staff Data Engineer plays a critical role in shaping, designing and delivering data and AI solutions that translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and reusable capabilities. Operating at staff level, this role provides senior technical leadership across data products, data platforms and AI-enabled solutions, with clear accountability for end-to-end system design, from high-level architecture through to low-level implementation design.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. The postholder independently identifies problems to solve, leads the technical design of solutions and acts as technical lead across one large-scale or multiple medium-scale delivery workstreams. A strong command of modern engineering patterns and practices is essential, as this role helps set the engineering standard for others to follow.
  
  
The role carries clear technical leadership accountability without line management responsibility. It guides delivery teams, influences internal and third-party engineering outcomes, and ensures solutions are well designed, maintainable, secure and fit for enterprise use. The postholder is also expected to mentor others and actively contribute to engineering excellence across the wider team.
  
  
You will work with
  
  
This role sits within the Finance Technology team and works closely with data engineers, data analysts, AI and software engineers, product managers, architects, cyber, platform and business stakeholder teams. It also partners with central technology and architecture teams to ensure solutions are designed for reuse, interoperability and future scalability, rather than being developed in isolation.
  
  
You will deliver
  
  
End-to-end system design: Translate high-level architectural direction into detailed, buildable solution designs. This includes decomposing architectural patterns, such as event-driven ingestion, medallion lakehouse and RAG pipelines, into concrete engineering specifications including table schemas, transformation logic, interface contracts, retry and error-handling strategies, SLA thresholds and observability requirements. Produce HLD artefacts that communicate solution intent and platform choices, alongside LLD artefacts that delivery engineers can implement without ambiguity. Design outputs should be reviewable through architecture governance and usable as the baseline for technical assurance.
  
  
Strong engineering practices and patterns: Set and reinforce standards for software design, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability and documentation. Advocate for and apply established engineering patterns, including event-driven architecture, microservices, pipeline orchestration, RAG and layered data architecture, using sound judgement on when each pattern is appropriate. Apply these patterns effectively across data-intensive pipelines, products and applications.
  
  
Scalable data infrastructure and product delivery: Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines, data products and integration layers that move, process and serve data across the enterprise at scale.
  
  
AI-enabled solution engineering: Integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into production-grade applications, including LLM-based solutions, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and unstructured data processing. Evaluate AI tooling pragmatically, prioritising measurable business value and sustainable delivery over experimentation for its own sake.
  
  
Technology selection, reuse and scalable solution design: Exercise strong technical judgement in determining when to build custom capability, configure or extend existing platforms, adopt SaaS solutions, or use low-code/no-code approaches. Ensure decisions consider both the immediate requirement and broader enterprise value, balancing delivery speed, maintainability, cost and scalability. Identify opportunities to reuse existing capabilities, create common patterns and shared services, adopt platform-based solutions and actively reduce unnecessary duplication and technical debt.
  
  
Technical governance and design assurance: Work with architecture, cyber, data governance and platform teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, resilience, compliance, performance and operational readiness.
  
  
Engineering leadership across internal and third-party teams: Provide technical direction and engineering leadership across internal teams, delivery partners and third-party suppliers. Set clear engineering expectations, challenge technical decisions where appropriate, and ensure delivered solutions meet required standards for quality, architecture, security, maintainability and long-term ownership.
  
  
Operational excellence and lifecycle ownership: Design for supportability, observability, reliability and cost effectiveness throughout the solution lifecycle. Define service reliability expectations, SLA requirements and appropriate site-reliability engineering practices for systems owned or technically led by the role.
  
  
Hands-on delivery and prototyping: Translate ambiguous problems into practical technology options, solution designs and working prototypes. Use modern engineering and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate design and
  
  
build activities, test assumptions and validate ideas rapidly with users before committing to larger-scale implementation.
  
  
Technical mentorship and engineering excellence: Mentor engineers across the team, contribute to data engineering learning and development, and actively participate in the evolution of engineering communities, standards, reusable patterns and practices.
  
  
What you will need to be successful
  
  
**Essential**

# Job Title: AI Data Engineer
  
  

* Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
* Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office (WFO)(886)
* Experience:\*\* 5–10 Years
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 45 Days

## Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced AI Data Engineer to design, develop, optimize, and operate scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data platform solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Kafka, Delta Lake, and ETL processes.
  
  
The role involves building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, ensuring data quality and platform performance, and implementing knowledge base and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to support agentic AI use cases.
  
  
## Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, optimize, and maintain production-grade batch and streaming data pipelines.
* Build and manage scalable data processing solutions using Azure, Databricks, PySpark, Python, SQL, Kafka, and Delta Lake.
* Develop robust ETL workflows for data ingestion, transformation, validation, and processing.
* Implement pipeline orchestration, monitoring, observability, error handling, and performance tuning.
* Develop and support knowledge base and RAG solutions for agentic AI applications.
* Ensure data quality, reliability, scalability, and security across data platforms.
* Apply enterprise data architecture principles, access controls, and cloud security best practices.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, release management, deployment, and production operations.
* Troubleshoot data pipeline issues and perform root cause analysis to maintain platform stability.
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, product owners, source-system teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into secure and maintainable solutions.
* Maintain technical documentation and participate in technical discussions and design reviews.

##
**Must-Have Skills**
###
**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Databricks.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation and validation.
* Practical experience with PySpark and Apache Spark for large-scale data processing.
* Experience with Apache Kafka and batch/streaming data pipelines.
* Strong understanding of Delta Lake and ETL processes.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and production data pipeline operations.
* Ability to independently design, build, optimize, monitor, and troubleshoot production pipelines.
* Understanding of enterprise data architecture, cloud security, access control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Experience with production support, error handling, observability, and performance optimization.

###
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or cloud-scale analytics delivery.
* Demonstrated ownership of production pipelines and platform components.
* Minimum 2 years of stability with an organization.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

## Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Hands-on experience implementing knowledge base solutions.
* Experience developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Familiarity with agentic AI use cases and AI data platform integrations.
* Experience with advanced data pipeline orchestration, observability, and operational automation.

## Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  

* Self-driven professional with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Detail-oriented, with a focus on data quality and production reliability.
* Capable of working independently and leading technical discussions.
* Strong stakeholder management, documentation, and communication skills.
* Candidates currently based in Pune or nearby locations are preferred.

## Interview Process
  
  

* 2 Technical Rounds
* 1 Client Round
* HR Discussion
* Important:\*\* This is a Work From Office role in Pune. Candidates should have relevant hands-on technical experience, strong communication skills, and be available to join within 45 days.

EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. **Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.

title: Data, Graph & ML Platform Engineer with Freight MNC - Remote
description:
Looking for A data engineer who models data as carefully as they run infrastructure, has dealt with revisions and point-in-time correctness in real pipelines, and has operated a graph database in production.

Responsibilities

● Data landing: connector framework with data contracts, delivery ledger, validation and quarantine; connectors for licensed vendor files and open sources; every record stamped with its three clocks (period, knowledge time, question time).

● Point-in-time store on object storage (Delta Lake): append-only revisions and vintages, an as-of read path that cannot return later-published information, staleness caps, lineage.

● Reference and identity layer: airports, lanes, corridors, regions, index hierarchy; identity resolution across sources with validity windows (Splink or rule-based).

● Graph layer (owner): generate the property-graph schema from the ontology (schema-as-code, LinkML); deterministic projections per as-of date; load and operate Neo4j (Aura) with a read-only product projection; write graph features back into the feature store as as-of columns; enforce that no licensed raw value or forecast leaks into the graph; keep the rebuild to one command and the GPU/graph-ML path open.

● Platform: Terraform on Google Cloud (or Azure/AWS), container jobs, Postgres with row-level security, orchestration with as-of partitions (Dagster or comparable), MLflow, CI/CD gates, observability, secrets, backups, cost control; keep the repository agent-ready (dev container, fixtures, contract tests, leak scans).

Must have

● Strong Python and SQL; DuckDB/Polars/Pandas; larger data pipelines with data contracts, schema evolution and data-quality checks.

● Point-in-time data correctness: as-of reads, publication lags, vintages and revisions, reproducibility.

● Production experience with Neo4j and Cypher: property-graph data modelling, loading at scale, query performance, operating a managed instance; understands the graph as a projection of tabular truth, not a system of record.

● Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform, one major cloud (GCP preferred), PostgreSQL, Parquet/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow, MLflow, logging and monitoring.

● Can turn "build a new macro-data connector" into a controlled agent workflow: spec → connector → fixtures → contract tests → data quality → CI → documentation → pull request.

title: Applied ML & Forecasting Lead for Freight MNC-Pune
description:
Responsibilities

● Build and maintain the forecasting arms behind one common interface: seasonal baselines, statistical models,

regularised linear models, LightGBM panel models with conformal calibration, and a pre-trained challenger

(Chronos-type foundation model).

● Own walk-forward backtesting, the sealed lockbox, prediction intervals, abstention rules and the router that picks an arm per market segment; hierarchical reconciliation from lane to corridor to index.

● Run the pre-registered signal-validation loop: screening of economic hypotheses, multiple-testing (false-

discovery-rate) control, bootstrap and placebo confirmation, and the out-of-sample gate that decides whether a signal enters the models.

● Graph: evaluate graph features through the same backtest fabric as every other feature; specify what the graph layer must deliver for forecasting; keep the door open for graph neural networks once the gates are met.

● Produce reproducible evaluation reports (skill vs. naive anchor, coverage, Diebold-Mariano) verifiable from a repository tag.

**Must have**

● Time-series, panel and multi-horizon forecasting in production (not only notebooks); LightGBM and regularised regression; temporal feature engineering.

● Rigorous evaluation: walk-forward and temporal cross-validation, leakage detection, point-in-time (as-of) correctness, calibration, conformal prediction, prediction intervals, model comparison.

● Statistics for signal discovery: lead/lag analysis, Granger-type tests, multiple testing and false-discovery-rate control, bootstrap methods.

● Strong Python, SQL, Pandas/Polars, experiment tracking (MLflow or comparable); containers, APIs and cloud basics.

● Can instruct a coding agent to implement a new forecasting arm with backtests, leakage checks and baseline comparison — and then judge whether the result is statistically correct.

**Nice to have**

Hierarchical forecasting and reconciliation; foundation models for time series; graph machine learning (PyTorch Geometric, heterogeneous graph models); basic Cypher; exposure to logistics, freight, commodities or financial time series.

Looking for Someone who has shipped forecasting models to production, not only in notebooks, and whose strength is statistics and time series rather than LLM applications.

**Common requirement**

AI-native engineering is mandatory. Daily, productive use of Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor or comparable agents; breaks work into

agent-ready specs and steers parallel tasks; reads, challenges and corrects AI-generated code; tests, CI/CD and evals as guardrails

(build → test → review → fix → merge → verify); fluent in Git, pull requests and code review; maintains CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md;Independent, remote, fluent English. Agent experience alone is not enough — LangChain/RAG/prompt-engineering profiles are not a fit.

**About the Role**

Energy Exemplar is the market leader in Energy Simulation Software. We exist so that our customers can make the most informed decisions at the most impactful times and want you to be part of that success. We are calling for
**Associate Energy Market Analyst (Data)**
to work with our team that develops simulation ready datasets in Pune location.

**Key Accountabilities and Duties**

**Accountabilities**

* Development and maintenance of Global (North America/Europe/APAC regions) Power Market models/dataset using PLEXOS/Aurora tools
* Asist in market research, model updates, result analysis, model benchmarking etc.
* Visualize and analyze production cost market model results using Power BI, Excel.

**Day to day duties:**

* Work in a team of energy data analysts.
* Work on projects to deliver standalone dataset and portions of dataset using fundamental data along with PLEXOS and Aurora power market models
* Analyzing power markets, undertaking research, analyzing and manipulating data and processing data for input into power market models

* Running PLEXOS and/or Aurora and interpreting output model results and energy balances
* Comparing models and reviewing preliminary forecast output results for inconsistencies to ensure deliveries meet product specification
* Problem solving and interpretation of market models and ability to detect errors and omissions
* Troubleshoot market models and intermediate work products for errors, omissions, and improvements.

**Foundation Skills:**

* Experience with energy market modelling
* High level of numeracy, computer, and web literacy.
* Basic understanding of energy economics for power market fundamentals and economic concepts of power markets.
* Knowledge of production cost modelling software’s like PLEXOS (preferred), Aurora or Pro-mod, or similar
* Good Knowledge of Power Plant/Natural Gas Economics, Power Systems, Gas supply chain, Operation research/Optimization techniques, statistics, and Energy (Power &/ Gas) Markets/Industry
* Knowledge and experience with transmission planning and nodal market modeling including generator mapping, assessing N-x contingencies, understanding and troubleshooting nodal model infeasibilities and other planning related power flow analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and see projects/assignments through from start to finish.
* Self-starter, organized, persistent, goal driven, has a can-do attitude, takes challenges as opportunities to perform and add value
* Diligent, systematic, and pays attention to detail to ensure work accuracy and quality
* Punctual, Professional work and phone etiquette.

**Experience:**

* 0-2 years of experience with Energy Modeling and Power Market Analysis.
* Knowledge of or experience working in several North American, European or Asian power markets.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques.
* Experience in creating and analyzing energy data sets for power models.
* Experience working at a market operator, project developer, or at a utility in planning or commercial operations would be an asset.
* Knowledge of one or more energy economic modeling tools: PLEXOS, Aurora, PROMOD, PSO, Market Analytics and/or PROSYM.
* Strong organizational skills, familiarity with Agile/Sprint Best Practices.
* Expert skills using Excel, Power BI and similar tools.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Transmission preferred), or Power Systems.
